text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Seventeen industrial investment opportunities offered at a seminar which opened in Bahrain on Tuesday.
- Bahrain International Bank offers new fund to invest in Omani equities.
- Bahrain's Securities and Investment Company posts 850,000 dinars in net profit in 1996.
- Bahrain to host a conference on aluminium industry in November.
- Bahrain studies projects to increase power and water capacity, electricity minister says.
- Development projects worth $400 million were approved in Bahrain in the past two years, oil minister says.
- Bahrain's Shura council approves a proposal allowing nationals of the United Arab Emirates to own land and real estate in Bahrain.
